evidence_required: A policy document (≤ 2 pages) and before/after simulator output for one rule.

marking.criterion: Eligibility filters in order, GPU-type selection, and topology rules (socket, node, rail, rack/block)
Quota model (hard, borrowing, overcommit), priority classes with preemption asymmetry, fairness key
Gang mechanism and how small jobs are kept from fragmenting gang capacity
Metrics that prove the policy works
Before/after simulator replay of one rule change with interpretation

title: ORION scheduling policy with replay evidence
